source: Label review page answers saved 2026-11-02. Each entry keeps the rule text and quotes the page showed, so a later rebuild can tell whether the label still applies. Notes are short summaries of the reviewer's comments, not quotes.

diagnosis.note: Depends on context: is this diagnosis the reason for this request, or only a condition the patient has?

dose.rule: The requested semaglutide dose is 0.5 mg weekly.

lab.rule: An A1c result is documented within 180 days before the request.

prior.rule: A metformin trial lasting at least 90 days is documented, or intolerance is documented.
quotes: Prior therapy: metformin 1000 mg twice daily; started 2026-04-01; stopped 2026-08-01; inadequate response documented.
prior.note: Technically yes, but a bare "inadequate response documented" may need more support: the value before treatment and the value after it that missed the goal.
